entities.summary: Wolverhampton is a city and metropolitan borough in the West Midlands of England. Located around 12 miles northwest of Birmingham, it forms the northwestern part of the West Midlands conurbation, with the towns of Walsall to the east and Dudley to the south. The population in 2021 was 263,700, making it the third largest city in the West Midlands after Birmingham and Coventry.
